title: claim_task
description: Claim a task with a lease and its file paths, so other agents cannot take overlapping paths. Fails with CLAIM_CONFLICT (holder and paths) when another live claim overlaps.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.

lease_minutes.description: How long the claim lasts (default 30). Renew by claiming again.

paths.description: File globs the task will touch. Default: the task's allowed paths.
